overview.description: The JPMorgan U.S. Large Cap Value Plus ETF (JLVP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation through exposure to a long/short US large-cap value portfolio. The strategy employs a fundamental approach that combines research, valuation, and stock selection to rank companies within industries based on relative value. JLVP was launched on Jul 30, 2026 and is issued by JPMorgan Chase.
